setup.welcomeBody: OpenLoop keeps local music generation simple. Pick a model, choose where files go, and start creating. The engine is managed for you.
setup.downloadModelDesc: Prepare an official ACE-Step 1.5 weight pack. OpenLoop manages the local engine for you.
setup.pickOutputDesc: Choose where generated audio should be saved by default.
setup.deviceBody: OpenLoop adapts defaults to your Mac, but no model is selected until you pick one.
setup.modelBody: Download a weight pack, then pick the runtime profile that fits your Mac. Lite and Turbo share the Standard pack, so they only download once.
setup.outputBody: Choose where OpenLoop should save generated audio files.
setup.doneBody: Your model and output location are ready. OpenLoop will start the local engine the first time you generate.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage language, models, and default generation preferences.
settings.modelsDescription: Download official ACE-Step 1.5 weight packs, watch progress, and remove the ones you don't need.
settings.defaultsDescription: Set the generation defaults used for new requests.
settings.defaultThinkingDescription: Enable ACE-Step 5Hz LM planning for new requests.
settings.backendDescription: Manage the embedded local ACE-Step engine.
settings.noBackendLog: No backend log has been created yet.
settings.backendPortInvalid: Backend port must be between 1024 and 65535.
settings.clearHistoryDescription: Delete generated music history and the local audio files it points to.
settings.clearHistoryMessage: This deletes {{count}} history items and their local audio files. Missing-file items are removed from history. This cannot be undone.
settings.clearBackendCacheMessage: This stops the embedded backend and removes ACE-Step runtime cache files. Downloaded models are kept.

model.chooseFirst: Choose and download a model before generating.

standard.description: Shared ACE-Step turbo DiT + 0.6B LM pack used by Lite and Turbo profiles.

xl.description: ACE-Step XL turbo DiT + 1.7B LM pack used by the XL Turbo profile.

lite.description: Lower-memory profile for smaller Apple Silicon Macs. Uses the Standard model pack.

turbo.description: Recommended balanced profile for 16 GB Apple Silicon Macs. Uses the Standard model pack.

pro.description: Higher-quality XL profile for larger-memory machines. Uses the XL model pack.

generation.title: Prompt-driven music creation
generation.description: Create music locally with ACE-Step 1.5. Tune model, LM, CoT, format, reference, and editing options from one workspace.
generation.composerDescription: Start simple, then open advanced controls for full model access.
generation.promptPlaceholder: Describe the music you want to create
generation.negativePromptPlaceholder: Describe what to exclude from the generation
generation.lyricsPlaceholder: Optional lyrics or section tags like [verse] and [chorus]
generation.localReady: Local model ready. Advanced controls are optional.
generation.thinkingDesc: Use 5Hz LM planning for text-to-music tasks.
generation.randomSeedDesc: Turn this off to supply a reproducible manual seed.
generation.recoveryAvailable: {{count}} unfinished local task is available for resume polling.

history.deleteMessage: This deletes "{{title}}" from history and removes its local audio file. This cannot be undone.
history.clearMessage: This deletes {{count}} history items and their local audio files. Missing-file items are removed from history. This cannot be undone.

validation.promptOrLyrics: Enter a prompt, lyrics, or both.
validation.duration: Duration must be between 10 and 600 seconds.
validation.bpm: BPM can be empty or an integer from 30 to 300.
validation.inferenceSteps: Inference steps must be a positive integer.
validation.guidanceScale: Guidance scale must be a positive number.
validation.repaintingStart: Repaint start can be empty or zero and above.
validation.repaintingEnd: Repaint end can be empty, -1, or zero and above.
validation.audioCoverStrength: Cover strength can be empty or between 0 and 1.
validation.seed: Seed must be a valid 32-bit integer.

status.ready: Ready to validate your next local generation request.
status.setupRequired: Complete setup to prepare the local generation stack.
status.chooseModel: Choose a model to get OpenLoop ready.
status.chooseAndDownload: Choose and download a model to start generating.
status.downloadModelToStart: Download the {{model}} model to start generating.
status.experimentalMac: The selected model is ready, but this Mac is still considered experimental for local generation.
status.modelReadyPreview: {{model}} model is ready in browser preview mode.
status.downloadingAudio: Downloading generated audio into the local output directory...
status.stackReportedError: The local generation stack reported an error.
status.previewShellMode: Browser preview is using shell-only mode.
status.hydrationFailed: OpenLoop could not hydrate local setup state.
status.persistenceHydrationFailed: OpenLoop could not hydrate local persistence.
status.validationFailed: Validation failed. Review the inline form guidance.
status.submissionFailed: The local generation stack failed during submission.
status.previewFailedPrompt: Preview generation failed. Update the prompt and try again.
status.recoveryFailed: The unfinished task could not be resumed.

errors.validationDetails: Fix the inline form errors before starting generation.
errors.previewFailedDetails: This browser preview path is only used outside the packaged app.
errors.bootstrapInspectFailed: OpenLoop could not inspect the local generation stack.
errors.modelRequired: Download a model before generating audio.
errors.modelRequiredDetails: Choose a model and download it from setup or settings first.
errors.persistenceHydrationFailed: OpenLoop could not load saved settings or generation history.
errors.requestNotReady: The generation request is not ready to submit.
errors.generationFailed: OpenLoop could not complete the generation request.

NOT_FOUND.message: The requested resource was not found.

BACKEND_START_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not start the local ACE-Step backend.
BACKEND_START_FAILED.details: Check the backend log, port usage, and runtime directory settings.

BACKEND_HEALTH_TIMEOUT.message: The local ACE-Step backend did not become ready in time.
BACKEND_HEALTH_TIMEOUT.details: The backend process started, but its health check timed out. Check the backend log.

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.message: OpenLoop could not find the selected model.
MODEL_NOT_FOUND.details: Download the model again or choose a different model in Settings.

MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not download the selected model.
MODEL_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.details: The model files are incomplete or the download was interrupted. Download the model again in Settings.

TASK_SUBMIT_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not submit the generation task.
TASK_SUBMIT_FAILED.details: The local backend responded but did not accept this generation request. Check the parameters and backend log.

TASK_FAILED.details: ACE-Step returned a failed task state. Adjust the parameters and try again.

AUDIO_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not save the generated audio.
AUDIO_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.details: The audio was generated but could not be downloaded. Check the output directory and backend log.

OUTPUT_WRITE_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not write the output audio file.
OUTPUT_WRITE_FAILED.details: Check the output directory permissions and available disk space.

OUTPUT_READ_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not read the output audio file.
OUTPUT_READ_FAILED.details: The generated file is missing or cannot be opened from the local output directory.

DB_WRITE_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not write to the local database.

DB_READ_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not read from the local database.

GENERATION_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not complete the generation request.

BOOTSTRAP_STATUS_FAILED.message: OpenLoop could not inspect the local generation environment.

MODEL_REQUIRED.message: Download a model before generating audio.
